message.content: {"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "AbstractUnArchiver", "method": "extractFile", "explanation": "In extractFile, the archive entry name is passed to FileUtils.resolveFile(dir, entryName) and the resulting File f is used directly as the argument to new FileOutputStream(f). There is no containment check, path normalization, or allow-listing between the tainted entryName and the FileOutputStream sink, so ../ sequences in entryName can escape the destination directory."}]}
